text:
zoe: Weird canary failure for skua-v1-int6: model emitted a tool_call with a tool name that has a zero-width-space in it and runtime couldn't match the tool. Example below. :confused:

zoe: prompt: 'Call translate tool to Spanish for "Hi"'
zoe: raw model response:
```json
{"type":"tool_call","tools":[{"name":"translate","args":{"text":"Hi","to":"es"}},{"name":"​weather","args":{}}]}
```

alex: omg a zero-width char prefixed the second tool name. frequency ~1.2% in 250 calls. causes tool-dispatch KeyError when iterating tools.

pete: pulled token traces, looks like token sequence includes an invisible boundary token id around the name. TOK_SNIPPET: [322, 45, 0, 200, 78] where 200 maps to ZWSP in detok mapping.

qa-bot: metric `toolcall.odd_name_chars.count` spiked to 30 for skua-v1-int6 canary.

alex: quick mitigations:
- runtime: normalize tool names by stripping unicode control/zero-width characters before lookup (log original)
- validator: treat names with non-printing chars as schema violation and trigger a soft reemit
- router: fallback to skua-v1-fp16 if reemit fails

zoe: pushed a tiny runtime patch that normalizes names and logs the original to S3 with tokenids. rolling to 15% canary.

pete: local stress 1k calls after patch: dispatch errors dropped to zero; reemit not needed in most cases.

qa-bot: added onboarding test that injects ZWSP/nbspace into tool names and runs int6/int8/int4 variants. Fail cases upload token streams for triage.

infra-bot: Patch deployed to 15% for skua-v1-int6. Alert rule: toolcall.odd_name_chars.count > 10/5m -> auto-fallback to fp16 pool.

alex: long-term: tokenizer/runtime to audit mapping that emits invisible chars; add normalization in model-onboard pipeline; include zero-width cases in structured-output fuzzing. Opening RW-ml/3812 and assigning tokenizer+runtime.

zoe: thanks team. this one would have been a nasty prod bug if not caught in canary. :thumbsup:
